description: Create a team tag (label) so feedback can be tagged with it by name in feedback_post and feedback_update. Idempotent: if a tag with the same name exists (case-insensitive), it is returned unchanged with created: false. Tags are shared by the whole team; call tags() first to reuse an existing one. Optional color (#RRGGBB).
name: tag_create
title: Create a team tag
